technique_name: Describe the elements used to create the exhibition.
description: The 'Theatre of Life' exhibition at the V&A museum consists of intricate set designs, elaborate costumes, scaled models, and dazzling interiors from the Baroque and Rococo periods.
example: The 'Theatre of Life' exhibition at the Victoria and Albert Museum features set designs, costumes, models, and interiors from the Baroque and Rococo periods of the 17th and 18th centuries.
